start: Admin app open in a browser; an uncaught error happens on the Members screen

steps.action: The admin app sends the error to /api/crash (source admin, message, stack, app version, screen name)
must_not: The admin app stops working because the report failed
A gym code, install id or device stored with the report

user_sees: One row labelled crash with the message, the app version and the screen
must_not: The crash row shown in the normal feedback sorting as a new message

start: Member phone app; a fatal error closes a screen

steps.action: The member app sends the error with source member and fatal true
must_not: The report refused because it came from the member app

steps.action: Send a GET instead of a POST
POST with source "watch", then with an empty message
must_not: A row saved for an unknown app or an empty message

steps.action: POST a body bigger than 7,200 letters
Send 31 different crashes from one network address in 24 hours
must_not: More than 30 rows from one address in a day
The free database flooded past 2,000 reports a day

start: One crash already reported today from this network address

steps.action: The same crash (same message shape and top stack lines) is sent again from the same address
must_not: A second row for the same crash
An error answer that makes the app retry

steps.action: 91 days pass; the daily clean-up runs at 03:00 India
user_sees: The crash row is gone from the feedback list
must_not: A crash row older than 90 days still kept
A normal feedback or help row deleted by the crash clean-up

start: An error message that happens to contain an email, a phone number and a key

steps.action: The app sends a crash whose message reads like "login failed for asha@x.com 98765 43210 key sk_live_..."
must_not: The email, phone or key stored
The network address stored as plain text (only a one-way daily hash)

steps.action: The daily GitHub job copies the new crash to the private bug list
user_sees: Only the scrubbed text and the signature
must_not: A member's name, gym or phone in the bug list
